request.description: Small pixel-art particle effect for a side-view horse race game, seen from the side: a dust puff kicked up behind a galloping hoof on a dry dirt track. A low cloud of dry sandy dust bursts from the ground, billows up and drifts backwards to the LEFT, grows, thins out and dissolves into a few specks. Soft beige-tan dust in 3-4 flat shades, chunky pixel clusters, no outline, no glow. 8 frames, canvas about 48x32 px, not looping, transparent background, crisp hard pixels, no anti-aliasing.
request.name: race-fx-dust

last_response.name: race-fx-dust
last_response.message: Made an 8-frame, non-looping dust puff on a transparent 48×32 canvas. It billows low, drifts left, and breaks into specks using four sandy shades with crisp pixels, no outline, and no glow.
